item.title: Wellfleet officials, Barnstable County Tech Rescue Team able to successfully locate missing woman
item.description: WELLFLEET – The Barnstable County Tech Rescue Team (BCTRT) was activated late Tuesday evening for a missing woman in Wellfleet. About 11 PM, the woman was located near Marconi and was evaluated by EMTs. Further details were not immediately available.
